Name: WarpAnimals
Author: Symenb
Description:
Mod for Stardew Valley that allows warping wandering farm animals into their
respective home.

[size=4]Use cases[/size]

* Animals normally go home by themselves at dusk, but sometimes they don't for some reason and they'll be unfairly grumpy the next day.

* You forgot to close the gates the day before and don't want to go retrieve every animal on your farm.

[size=4]Installation[/size]

* Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI 2.11.2 or later[/url].

* [url=https://github.com/simonbru/WarpAnimals/releases]Download[/url] and unzip this mod into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].

[size=4]Usage[/size]

Press [font=Courier New]K[/font] to warp animals. It is possible to configure the key or gamepad button in [font=Courier New]config.json[/font]. Set the key to [font=Courier New]null[/font] to disable the shortcut.

There is also a console command [font=Courier New]warp_animals[/font] in case you don't want to reserve a key just for this.

[size=4]Notes[/size]

Source code is [url=https://github.com/simonbru/WarpAnimals]on GitHub[/url].

I only did a quick test for the gamepad binding since I don't play with a gamepad.

You may want to check [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1019/?]AutoAnimalDoors[/url] if you don't want to manage the animal doors at all. This will also warp your animals automatically if needed.
